title: Front End Developer
description:
Role

As a **Front\-End Developer**, you will focus on building responsive web applications and cross\-platform mobile interfaces. You should be a team player with a strong eye for visual design, user experience (UX), and interface utility.

You'll be part of a cross\-functional team, translating UI/UX design wireframes into high\-quality, clean code. You will collaborate with backend developers and product teams to implement features, perform unit testing, and ensure high performance across both web browsers and mobile devices.

Responsibilities

* **Build reusable code** and libraries for future use across web and mobile platforms.
* **Develop user\-facing features** using modern JavaScript frameworks.
* **Optimize applications** for maximum speed, scalability, and responsiveness.
* **Collaborate with UI/UX designers** to bridge the gap between graphical design and technical implementation.
* **Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade** existing web and mobile interfaces.
* **Ensure cross\-browser compatibility** and smooth mobile device performance.

Skills and Personal Characteristics

* **1–2 years of professional experience** in front\-end web and/or mobile development.
* **Strong proficiency** in core front\-end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6\+).
* **Hands\-on experience** with JavaScript frameworks like **ReactJS** (for web) and **React Native** or **AngularJS** (for mobile/web).
* **Familiarity with mobile responsive design** principles and mobile app deployment basics.
* **Experience with version control tools** like Git.
* **Good communication skills** and the flexibility to adapt quickly in a startup environment.
* **Great attention to detail** with a knack for pixel\-perfect UI implementation.
* **Exposure to Agile methodologies** like Scrum or Kanban is a plus.

Educational Qualifications

* **B.E / B.Tech** in Computer Science or related engineering streams
* **B.Sc / M.Sc** in Computer Science / IT
* **BCA / MCA**
* *Note: Driven freshers with a strong portfolio of projects/internships in React/React Native are welcome to apply.*

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Experience:

* React: 1 year (Preferred)

Location:

* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu (Required)

Work Location: In person
